evidence.claim: Gilead supplies lenacapavir to organisations at no profit to the company until generics can meet demand; PEPFAR and the Global Fund committed to supply up to two million people over three years from September 2025, expanded by a further one million in April 2026.

Gilead signed non-exclusive, royalty-free voluntary licensing agreements with six manufacturers to make and sell generic lenacapavir in 120 high-incidence, resource-limited countries, signed in advance of global regulatory submissions.

Gilead reached a $246.8 million class settlement with direct purchasers of its HIV medications over allegations it agreed with Teva to delay generic versions, covering overpayments for Atripla and Truvada between February 2018 and September 2022.
